articles.title: Why Jim Cramer’s quantum panic isn’t rattling bitcoin as price holds steady around $64,000
articles.snippet: Jim Cramer says he's dumping his bitcoin over quantum computing fears, but his track record of crypto and bank calls has buoyed the crypto community.

articles.title: BNY to offer institutional crypto staking through Galaxy partnership
articles.snippet: The custody giant is expanding beyond safekeeping by adding staking services, allowing eligible institutional clients to earn yield on proof-of-stake assets.

articles.title: Sorry everyone, Bitcoin is headed down to $43,500: Michael Terpin
articles.snippet: Transform Ventures founder Michael Terpin says Bitcoin could have another 30% downside from its current price before he is confident the market has reached a bottom.

articles.title: Five Convicted of Imprisoning Crypto Millionaires in London 'Torture' Ordeal
articles.snippet: Two of the five were also convicted of conspiracy to blackmail, in a case police won without either victim testifying.

articles.title: Marmot Researchers Turn to OnlyFans for Funding—And There Are Meme Coins Too
articles.snippet: Scientists are using OnlyFans to help fund decades of marmot research, while unofficial memecoins inspired by the project have emerged on Solana.
